mapper.select: SELECT id, email, password, nickname, phone, profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl, provider, role, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM users WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, email, password, nickname, phone, profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl, provider, role, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE nickname = #{nickname}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (email, password, nickname, phone, profile_image_url, provider, role, status) VALUES (#{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{phone}, #{profileImageUrl}, COALESCE(#{provider}, 'LOCAL'), COALESCE(#{role}, 'ROLE_USER'), COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'))
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET nickname = #{nickname}, phone = #{phone}, profile_image_url = #{profileImageUrl}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET password = #{password}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
